# Community conduct

Treat collaborators respectfully regardless of background, identity or level of
experience. Welcome questions, credit contributions, and critique evidence and
ideas rather than people.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, unwanted contact, and publishing
another person's private information are not acceptable. Maintainers may remove
content or restrict participation to protect the project community.

Report concerns privately to the maintainer through the contact listed on
[the maintainer profile](https://github.com/qhuang20). Do not post sensitive
reports in a public issue. Reports will be reviewed with discretion; only share
information needed to understand and address the concern.
